title: [Decision] Merge queue: stop the remaining test shards once one shard is red (merge_group only), which narrows ruling 6139629628 A1 inside the queue
body:
coordinator#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmRWWb3MUYRQZiCKQcX

Filing gate ②, a decision only the maintainer can make. It comes from recommendation 2 of the 2026-11-08 CI assessment (window 2026-11-01..07). The maintainer answered that assessment in the project thread, verbatim: 「同意，立卡」 · 「高优先」 (2026-11-08T12:30Z). The assessment did not cite ruling 6139629628 (#23177, letter B, item A1), and this change narrows A1 inside the merge queue, so the card asks for that one point instead of reading the 「同意」 as covering it. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

- **问题**：合并队列里一个测试分片已经红了，其余分片还会跑完（Test Core 最慢片约 19 分钟），聚合检查要等它们跑完才报红，排在后面的条目也就晚这么久才重建。
- **冲突**：评估建议只在合并队列（`merge_group`）上给 Test Core、Test UI、Dogfood 三个矩阵开 fail-fast。#23177 的裁决 A1（「一轮 CI 暴露全部红」）要求一处红不挡住其它检查。开了 fail-fast，队列里就只看得到第一个红分片。PR 上的运行不变，仍然一轮看全。
- **要你选**：A 只在队列里开 fail-fast（推荐）；B 保持现状。
- **收益有上限**：它只管 CI 的测试矩阵。11-06 最大的一次级联红（65 次队列构建）出在 Lint 的 Test-source alias gate，A 帮不上那一次。

## Background (measured, Actions REST, all `CI` and `Lint` runs 2026-11-01..07)

- 1,840 `merge_group` runs of each workflow for 1,415 merged commits. Red: `CI` 125, `Lint` 121. Of the 225 red queue builds, 66 were roots and 157 cascades (a build whose parent group was already red).
- Test Core shard medians on a 2026-11-06 sample: 1/8 14.6, 2/8 10.9, 3/8 15.1, 4/8 19.0, 5/8–8/8 9.7–10.2 min. An early red in a fast shard waits for the slowest one before `Test Core` reads red.

## Governing text

- Ruling 6139629628 (#23177, letter B), item A1: "every gate step of a `Lint · *` lane and of `Type Check · *` keeps running after a red … Test Core runs `turbo run test … --continue=dependencies-successful` so one package's red does not stop the others; its verdict stays red." Its motive, in the card body: a release had to wait several CI rounds because each round showed one red.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` on `main` e516cf22: `strategy.fail-fast: false` on `test` (≈L873), `test-ui` (≈L2435) and `dogfood` (≈L3815).
- `ci.yml` ≈L2777–2786 (Dogfood Regression Gate): `cancelled` passes without counting (#3668), and "a real shard failure DOMINATES the aggregate … it reads `failure`, never `cancelled`" (verified on run 30271824408, a fail-fast matrix).
- Protocol: none. This changes CI scheduling only.

## Premises, each with a re-check

1. A real red still reads red under fail-fast. Re-check: the ci.yml note above and run 30271824408.
2. The mechanism must be the matrix's own `fail-fast`, never a run-level cancel: a matrix that is `cancelled` with zero attestations passes its aggregate (#3668). Re-check: `node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs --self-test`.
3. PR runs stay complete: the expression is false for `pull_request`, `push` and `schedule`. Re-check: the event list in the PR diff.

## Options

| Option | What it does | What people notice | Work |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A. Queue-only fail-fast** | `fail-fast: ${{ github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}` on `test`, `test-ui`, `dogfood` | A red queue entry is ejected minutes to 10+ minutes sooner, and the entries behind it rebuild sooner. In the queue run the author sees the first red shard only; their PR run already showed every red. | `domain:devx` · 1 Tier H PR on `ci.yml` (plus self-test fixtures if they pin `fail-fast: false`) · no precedent |
| B. Keep | Nothing | Every red queue entry holds the queue until its slowest shard ends | none |

**In business terms.** A: when the smoke alarm goes off in one room, evacuate now instead of waiting for every room's inspection. B: finish every inspection first, then evacuate.

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性: A 把「一轮看全」留给 PR（作者需要它的地方），队列只负责尽快判出能不能合；主流合并队列（GitHub merge queue、Bors、Mergify）都把队列构建当作快速判定。
② 实际业务拉动: 一周 125 次 CI 队列红，每次后面最多 10 个条目等它；今天就有人在等。
③ 防 AI 犯错: 真红仍是响亮的红（主导聚合检查）；风险是有人把它改成取消整次运行，那会静默放行（#3668），所以执行时只能用矩阵自带的 fail-fast。
④ 创业阶段不扩散: 改一个表达式，三处，不加门禁。
Prior rulings read: "fail-fast" (105 hits), "一轮 CI 暴露全部红" → #23177 / 6139629628; "cancelled" → #3668; ADR none; thread: the 2026-11-08 assessment thread.

**Recommendation: A.** Only facet ① was used to pick it: the queue's job is a fast mergeable/not-mergeable answer, and the complete red list belongs to the PR run. Do ②③④ flip it: no. Confidence gap: the minutes saved per red were not measured (they depend on which shard reds first); the first week after landing is the reading.

## After the ruling

A → the `domain:devx` seat files nothing new: this card becomes the execution card (`pm:queue`, p1). One Tier H PR, `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, and the maintainer's approval for `ci.yml`. The PR re-anchors any self-test fixture that pins `fail-fast: false` (`check-shard-attestation.mjs`, `check-aggregator-roster.mjs`, `partition-test-shards.mjs`) and amends the A1 wording in the ci.yml comments to say the queue is the exception. Reading after landing: queue time from first red shard to `Test Core` red, 7 days, on this card.
B → close as not planned.

## Dedupe

Search 2026-11-08 12:3xZ: "fail-fast merge_group" 8 hits, "fail-fast matrix" 28, "\"fail-fast\"" 105, all unrelated or closed (#23177 and #23191 are the ruling and its execution). **New.**
